diagrams.title: New STRIDE diagramUniversity Digital Library

threats.title: Search & Download Resources / Cloud Files
threats.description: An attacker may send a large number of requests to the library system, consuming server resources and preventing legitimate students and teachers from accessing
threats.mitigation: Apply rate limiting, traffic filtering, resource monitoring, and suitable availability protection.

threats.title: Unauthorized Login
threats.description: An attacker may steal a student's or teacher's password and log in using their account without permission. This could expose private account information or allow unauthorized actions.
threats.mitigation: Use multi-factor authentication (MFA), strong passwords, secure password hashing, and login rate limiting.

threats.title: Session Token Theft
threats.description: An attacker may steal a valid session token and use it to impersonate a logged-in user without knowing the user's password.
threats.mitigation: Use HTTPS, secure session cookies, appropriate token expiration, and session invalidation after logout.

threats.title: Manage User & Permissions
threats.description: A student may exploit weak access controls to gain librarian or administrator privileges and modify accounts or library resources.
threats.mitigation: Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), enforce least privilege, and verify permissions on the server for every sensitive action.

threats.title: User Accounts & Roles DB / Resource Catalogue & Files
threats.description: An attacker may modify user roles, book records, or digital files without authorization, affecting the integrity of library data.
threats.mitigation: Enforce database access controls, validate changes, restrict write permissions, and maintain secure backups.

threats.title: Audit Log Store
threats.description: An attacker or unauthorized user may delete or modify audit logs to hide suspicious activities, making security investigations difficult.
threats.mitigation: Restrict log access, use centralized tamper-resistant logging, and maintain protected log backups.

threats.title: Repudiation of Actions
threats.description: A librarian may deny uploading, deleting, or modifying a resource if the system does not maintain reliable records of who performed the action and when.
threats.mitigation: Record authenticated user IDs, timestamps, and resource changes in protected audit logs.

threats.title: Search & Download Resources / Cloud Files
threats.description: A user may access restricted research papers, private account details, or other protected information because of incorrect permissions or insecure cloud storage settings.
threats.mitigation: Enforce authorization checks, encrypt sensitive data in transit and at rest, and configure cloud storage permissions securely.
